title: Rosa Salcedo
body: Field rounds 4–6. Water issue recorded at the end of each round. Access ends when the road closes. Reverse: call Mum before dark.
rival_reading: Officials could issue a field credential with a closure rule during an emergency; a water allowance and a personal reminder do not prove a program malfunction.
gloss: A field credential joins water issue records to access that ends at a road closure.

title: The tool stayed after the row
body: A row on the map is marked twice, once after the road closed. The shovel is clean except for a strip of pale dust. Its return tag is signed; the field result is not.
rival_reading: A response crew could finish a marked row after a closure and return its tool; an unsigned result does not establish an agricultural malfunction.
gloss: A returned field tool and a late row mark leave the result unrecorded.
